pr_title: Fix preview window size in visual shader editor

issue_context.title: [4.0-rc1] Visual Shader "Show Generated Code" button broken
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

4.0.rc1

### System information

macOS 13.1, Apple M1

### Issue description

The "Show Generated Code" button in Visual Shader no longer works (it was working in 4.0.beta17.) It merely changes color when clicked, but the window with the shader code no longer opens.

![Screenshot 2023-02-09 at 09 26 38](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1061/217757845-22063e28-d94e-4ddb-8337-43f2797677ae.png)


### Steps to reproduce

1) Create any project with a visual shader (or use the attached MRP)
2) Click the "Show Generated Shader Code" button

### Minimal reproduction project

[MRP-Visual-Shader-Show-Generated-Code.zip](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/files/10694943/MRP-Visual-Shader-Show-Generated-Code.zip)
comments:

On macOS, you don't even get the small window (and I couldn't find any other way to switch to it.)
